content: In our annotations, Frequency has conflicting tags (e.g. {`Once a day', `twice a day'} and `daily'), hence metrics like Exact Match will be erroneous. To address this issue, we use the ROUGE scores to compare different models on the 10% test dataset and we use qualitative evaluation to measure the top-performing models on $\mathcal {D}_{test}$.
